name: vision-referral-database

scripts.check: npm run data && npm run validate && npm run smoke && node scripts/corpus-lock.mjs --check
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:demo && npm run fitness && git diff --exit-code -- site/data

_comment: There is deliberately NO "build" script. This site is plain static files and scripts/ is excluded from the deployment by .vercelignore, so a script named "build" makes Vercel try to run something it does not have. Data files under site/data/ are generated locally with "npm run data" and committed.
